posts.author: doug694
posts.post_subject: List of links to parts etc.
posts.content_md:
I just wanted to mention that I had picked up a couple of Resonant OCs and q-switch assemblies from:

[http://www.midwest-laser.com/html/ruby_laser.html](http://www.midwest-laser.com/html/ruby_laser.html) 

..and found the units to be good.

Actually, they were very dirty and on quick inspection the coatings were patchy and looked like they might be beyond repair. However with some patience, alcohol and about 30 minutes of careful cleaning the items are as-new. I think they have just been sitting collecting dirt for a very long time.

Doug.

posts.topic_title: List of links to parts etc.
posts.author: doug694
posts.post_subject: List of links to parts etc.
posts.content_md:
..I also thought it was worth mentioning that I picked up a supply of L8792 lamps from junktronix (ebay) much earlier this year and was very impressed with both the lamps and the seller. I also purchased a few L5007 and mercury capillary lamps for different projects. 

All of the lamps were sealed and in perfect condition. In every case, the seller sent me extra lamps as freebies (I purchased a final clearance of 10 mercury lamps at a very low price and got 18!).

(BTW if anyone can use high pressure mercury lamps then just ask, as I have plenty of spares now They produce mainly visible and UV, designed for CW but I intend to simmer/pulse them at low duty cycle in a dye laser.

Doug.
